risk_summary: The disclosure is quantitatively detailed but highlights substantial operating deterioration, including a 33% sales decline, an 84% net income decline, and a 66% Adjusted EBITDA decline driven largely by OSB pricing and volume pressure. Cyclical housing demand, inflation, supply disruptions, labor challenges, commodity-price volatility, and impairment-estimation uncertainty create meaningful forward credit risks. Boilerplate forward-looking disclaimers and reliance on management estimates temper the precision of the outlook.
